footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes a $33.4M income tax benefit.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 70.9% to $487M in 2025. Gross margin was 60.2%, versus 62.4% a year earlier, and the operating loss widened to $1.0B from $119M.
The net loss widened to $1.0B, or −$14.06 per share, from $117M. Operating cash flow was $16.3M and free cash flow $15.9M, versus −$65.3M.
sources: TechTarget, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
